source: TI SLUSE99C Tables8-12..8-20; SLUSDJ8A Table7-1 and section7.3
pack_profile: ConfigA110mAh candidate only; vendor voltage/current/NTC approval required before charging

startup_sequence.meaning: CHG_DIS=1, ICHG_CODE32; charging disabled during setup
retain default10% termination and100C junction thermal regulation; not a skin temperature guarantee
TS enabled,6h safety timer,160s register-reset watchdog retained
4.5V SYS when input present; normal power path; no pass-through
TS_HOT=11 nominal45C; TS_COLD=00 nominal0C; based on approved10kNTC R/T curve
verify configuration, TS status, pack approval and no fault; any mismatch keeps charging disabled
enable50mA only after the pack approval gate and readback pass

watchdog_policy.note: Any host I2C transaction resets the watchdog. On reset/reconnect reapply and read back configuration; do not silently disable safety features.
watchdog_policy.default_state_blocker: POR/watchdog default10mA and hot60C occur before host config. Pack safety review must accept this or add independent validated cutoff; cannot claim45C hardware cutoff.

bq25170.usb_mode: Q_CHG_ISO_R disconnects right cell from OR input; Q_CHG_MUTE_R holds right amplifier shutdown. Valid5V cable behavior is design intent, not a measured result.
bq25170.remaining_gate: weak or slowly collapsing VBUS, fault transients, isolation leakage and actual termination must be measured

configB47mAh: BLOCKED: current and safety-time profile must be separately approved and changed in both hardwareRISET and left register configuration; no capacity-based charge-rate assumption
